formattedAddress: 7th Cross Rd, Margosa Rd, Malleshwaram, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560003
infoParagraph: Iconic 1920s heritage breakfast institution celebrated for its crisp butter benne masala dose and slow-dripped chicory filter coffee.

authenticity.localSentimentSummary: Beloved generational eatery patronized by decades of local Bangaloreans.
authenticity.recommendedTiming: Early weekday morning around 7:45 AM before queues form.
authenticity.practicalTips: Cash or UPI only. Ask for 'benne dose' with extra white butter on the side.
authenticity.greetingCard: Welcome to Shri Sagar CTR! Savor the legendary crisp golden dose that has fueled Bengaluru mornings for over 70 years.
